overall_reason: A shadcn token layer with a class-based dark theme sits under the page, but type is set in 23 sizes with half-pixel steps from bracketed utilities, cards use two radii for one recipe, and the dark theme leaves status roles and Tailwind literals behind.

score.reason: T-SCALE-FIT fails on 23 font sizes with half-pixel steps (TOK-003), T-VALUE-INVENTORY on the 14/16px card radii and 9 shadow recipes (TOK-004), and T-THEME-PARITY on the status roles (TOK-009).

findings.where: hero meta, buttons, the product preview and section labels; 1440 and 375 (tiles/1440-00.png)
findings.evidence: values.1440.font_size has 23 sizes with on_token_share 0.013: 9, 9.5, 10, 10.5, 11, 11.5, 12, 12.5, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 19, 20, 21 and up. They come from bracketed utilities (frameworks.tailwind.arbitrary_value_classes: text-[9.5px], text-[10.5px], text-[11.5px], text-[12px], text-[13px], text-[15px], text-[17px], text-[19px], text-[21px], text-[2.6rem]). The hero meta line is 13px, the hero CTA 15px, a button label 12.5px. The type_ladder sweep hit counts the same 23 sizes.
findings.before: Nine sizes between 9 and 13px, half a pixel apart
findings.after: Three small steps (12, 14, 16) from the Tailwind scale; the product preview may keep one smaller label step
findings.why: Half-pixel steps are invisible as hierarchy and make every new label a fresh choice.

findings.where: feature and module cards, hero stage, header buttons; 1440 (tiles/1440-03.png)
findings.evidence: card_kit hits show the same shadow recipe (0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.06)) on 83 containers at 14px and 9 containers at 16px. values.1440.radius has 8 values (14, 8, full, 16, 10, 32, 12, 6) and shadow has 9 recipes with 6 one-offs. Radius declarations are 43% literal against 31% var.
findings.before: One card recipe at two radii; 9 shadow recipes
findings.after: One card radius token (14px) and at most two shadows, resting and raised
findings.why: Two radii on the same card recipe make the grids read as two components.

findings.evidence: theme.semantic_colour_redefined_share is 0.9: --info, --success and --warning and their foregrounds are not redefined for dark. theme.dark_rules_colour_declarations has 23 literal colours, including dark:bg-amber-950/20, dark:border-emerald-800/50 and a shimmer gradient in rgb() values.
findings.before: Dark mode swaps 54 of 60 roles and patches the rest with Tailwind palette literals
findings.after: Redefine --info, --success and --warning (and foregrounds) in the dark block and replace the dark: palette literals with those roles
findings.why: Status badges such as 'Due today' and 'In progress' keep light-mode colours or ad hoc ambers in dark mode.

findings.evidence: declarations.arbitrary_value_selectors includes .z-[60], .z-[100], .z-[9996], .z-[9997], .z-[9998], .z-[9999], .z-[10000], .z-[10001] and .z-[10010]. The rendered ladder is -10, 0, 1, 20, 50.
findings.before: Nine bracketed z-index values climbing past 10000
findings.after: A named layer ladder (base, raised, sticky, overlay, modal, toast) in the theme
findings.why: Escalating one-off layers lead to stacking fights when a new overlay arrives.

findings.evidence: colour_border.near_duplicates pairs #edebe9 (82) with #e8e6e3 (2); colour_fill pairs #f8f8f6 (6) with #f4f3f1 (3), both 0.014 to 0.016 OKLab apart. values.1440.duration has 18 values (150, 200, 620, 400, 600, 300, 450 ...).
findings.before: Two border greys and two warm surfaces a hair apart
findings.why: The pairs do one job and only add maintenance.

strengths: Colour declarations are 85% var() over a full shadcn role set (20 of 20) with brand orange as --primary.
Spacing sits on 4px (98% on the 4px grid at 1440).
not_investigated: The dark theme was read from the stylesheet only; the capture renders the light scheme.
The hero product preview is labelled 'PRODUCT PREVIEW · SAMPLE DATA'; some small sizes live there, but the table did not separate it.
Visitor mode inferred as Persuade (team workspace product landing page); no contract.
T-SYSTEM-DRIFT: no contract and no supplied design system or token file, so drift from a system could not be judged.
Inline style attributes: the DOM records computed styles, not which rule or inline style set a value.
Token source files (Sass, JSON token files, Figma variables) behind the shipped CSS were not available.
States the capture did not open (hover, focus, open menus, dialogs): their values were not in the table.
